title: A-H 300 - Topics in Art History and Visual Studies
prerequisites: At least one Art History and Visual Studies course at the 100- level required. Because A-H 300 is the GCCR course for the major, students must have completed 30 credit hours, including both CIS/WRD 110 and CIS/WRD 111
attributes: Meets Graduate Composition and Communication Requirement
repeatability: Repeatable to a maximum of 6According to the subtitle, this writing-intensive undergraduate seminar examines topics in art history and visual studies that are explicitly not limited by geographical location and/or period in history.
